trials_detail.reason: Reconstructs the complete stationary Gaussian dynamics in actual (r,v,q) coordinates and measures heat at the overdamped coupler: h^2/b times the spring-extension variance minus the two-dimensional Stratonovich correction 2hT_b/b. The supplied (r,v,z) dynamics are exactly related to (r,v,q) by z=-h(r-q), so this statement does not establish a source-dynamics defect.
